title: Typed DVCMin model
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 3. Step 2 — Assemble the payload; DVCMin logical model (trust-phw).

statements.label: Typed DVCMin model
statements.requirement: The library SHALL provide a typed DVCMin payload with the short element names and cardinalities of the logical model: n 1..1, dob 1..1, s 1..1, nt 1..1, id 0..1, dt 0..1, gn 0..1, vx 1..1, v 1..1, and a PayloadCodec for it.

successCriteria.criterion: PR 129 example as a conformance vector (req:stt-tst-001) passes.

sources.quote: The DVC payload uses short element names because every byte is paid for twice
